name: Point of Interest Network
description: The registry of places worth finding, and the state of finding them: unknown, rumoured, discovered, cleared. Discovery is driven by exploration — walking into the radius, spotting from a vista — and each state transition is emitted exactly once, because map markers, quest hooks, and fast-travel unlocks all hang off the same transition and a duplicate 'discovered' double-counts all three. This component owns the registry and the discovery state machine. It does not own the marker glyphs (ui.minimap renders what it is told), the travel (world.waypoint_travel moves you once a POI unlocks a node), or what lives at the site — a POI is a promise of content, and world.dynamic_encounter_spawner or a quest decides whether the promise is kept.

inputs.name: poiRegistry
inputs.description: POI definitions keyed by id: position, type, level band, discovery radius override. Content as data — adding a shrine is a content patch, not a code patch.

inputs.name: defaultDiscoveryRadius
inputs.description: How close the player must get before an unremarkable POI reveals itself. Vista-type POIs override this upward in their data; a mountain should be found from far away.

inputs.name: rumourRevealsMarker
inputs.description: Whether hearing about a place (dialogue, note, quest) places a vague map marker before discovery. True makes rumours tangible; false keeps the map honest-but-sparse.

outputs.name: discoveredPois
outputs.description: Ids in discovered or cleared state.

outputs.name: poiStates
outputs.description: Full state map: unknown | rumoured | discovered | cleared.
